subject: Nariway Weekly - 2026-08-24
html:
Nariway Weekly

The vault got richer. The pipeline didn’t move.

Last week’s move

This is the first Monday run. There is no prior move to grade yet. Next Monday checks the one below.

The challenge

The case dataset grew from 68 to 83 this week, and a sixth disconfirmation pass tested the report’s own coherence claim. Real work. None of it touched the number that matters. Tier-1 still reads zero paid engagements, zero real situations, one discovery conversation, and that conversation is Dawn, closed since August 13. Leslie Anderson is the only live thread pointing at a real situation, and it has sat untouched since August 20 despite three straight nudges. Ask honestly whether the vault is growing because the work demands it, or because it’s more comfortable than sending the next email.

This week’s one move

Send Leslie Anderson the two bridge questions today, before her draft closes for good. Route through PR contact Jo Marie Hebeler. Ask how often a family actually reaches the point of deciding what happens to a collection, and whether there is a family she is working with now where this is live. Matthew Erskine’s equivalent window already closed unrecovered. This is the last one.

One provocation

Four boutique firms, Art Fiduciary Advisors, Legacy Art Partners, smART Advisory, and Bultman Advisory, are independently pitching close to H7A’s exact thesis right now, one led by Christie’s Americas’ former president. The evidence base reads this as proof someone else senses the same gap.

It could just as easily mean the gap is already being filled, faster than Nariway is testing it. Which is it, and how would you know before one of them closes a client first?

Toi
